links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of ChatGPT responses versus web search results
links.effect: ChatGPT FRE 42.3 ± 13.1 vs web search 55.6 ± 10.5 (p < 0.001), i.e., ChatGPT responses harder to read; additional prompting improved FRE to 55.6 ± 13.6.
links.quote: The average readability for ChatGPT responses was lower than traditional web search (FRE: 42.3 ± 13.1 vs. 55.6 ± 10.5, p < 0.001), while the PEMAT understandability was equivalent (93.8% vs. 93.5%, p = 0.17).
